text:
gina (procurement): Heads up — AlphaLogistics updated ETA for the A800 wave. Partial shipment arriving Wed 06:00 UTC (AWB 1234-5678), remainder in 3-4 business days. Need confirmation on RMA label flow and serial manifest reconciliation. @supply-broker any update on customs HS change and commercial invoice?

supply-broker (alpha-logistics): Hi Gina — confirmed partial AWB 1234-5678 is cleared to move but forwarder flagged an HS reclass to 8471.80 which triggered extra duty. We can re-route via FRA hub to avoid a 48h hold, but expedited handling +$420. AWB and manifest attached to our portal: https://al-logistics.example/ship/1234

kazu (fleet): Can we accept partial arrival? Staging needs >=40 units to hit EU pool window. If partial <40 we either hold or air-topup. What's the partial qty?

gina (procurement): Partial is 28 units. Rest ~62 arriving later.

ellie (ops): Also, initial manifest flagged 3 serials with soft-DOA notes from vendor QC. Depot will reject DOA cases without pre-created RMA and return labels. @rma-bot can you pre-create for AWB 1234-5678 and note depot acceptance criteria?

rma-bot: created provisional RMA #RMA-42042 for AWB 1234-5678. Please attach serial list + photos. Depot requires return labels (PDF 4x6) and a signed credit agreement for DOA claims within 48h of receipt. If labels missing shipment will be quarantined.

supply-broker (alpha-logistics): We can provide return labels for DOA units but need clarification on liability split. Vendor covers DOA found within 7 days; after that it becomes customer liability. Alternatively we can offer a $200/unit credit for soft-fail units to avoid full return — vendor prefers credit to reduce reverse-logistics.

marie (finance): Need numbers. If we take expedite + vendor credit what’s the net cost vs waiting 3-4 days? Quick sketch: expedite $420, duty est $1,200, reship DOA handling $120/unit, vendor credit option $200/unit. Who has exact duty calc?

ellie (ops): Quick back-of-envelope: expedite $420 + duty $1,200 + 3 * $120 handling = $360; if vendor credits $200/unit for the 3 units = $600 credit. Net = $420 + $1,200 + $360 - $600 = $1,380 (approx). If we instead wait 3 days, opportunity cost for delayed capacity ~ $3,200 (est). :thinking_face:

kazu (fleet): Waiting costs ops more than expedite net. I prefer expedite. We risk losing staging window.

gina (procurement): We need written credit terms. Marie — finance wants a signed amendment that vendor accepts full liability for DOA within 7 days and waives the $420 expedite if we commit to an allocation uplift of +10 units from the next wave. @supply-broker — can you confirm in writing?

supply-broker (alpha-logistics): We can waive the $420 expedite fee if Redwood signs a one-time SOW amendment for +10 units uplift in next committed wave. We'll provide signed amendment and the serial list for the uplift by EOD tomorrow. We will also issue return labels as PDFs (4x6).

gina (procurement): Perfect. Drafting the amendment now. Also ops needs serial manifest reconciliation — attaching snippet to vendor ops channel.

ellie (ops): Manifest snippet (for vendor):

```
AWB: 1234-5678
units (partial arrival):
- S/N A800-009812
- S/N A800-009813  (soft-fail QC)
- S/N A800-009814
... (total 28)
```

Please send full serials for the +10 uplift so we can pre-stage. Reminder: depot will only accept PDF labels; rma-bot will reject other formats.

rma-bot: reminder — attach labels as PDF 4x6. If not attached, depot quarantine = true.

kazu (fleet): Ok moving to expedite route based on uplift + waived fee. Final ask: vendor to confirm which 10 units are uplifted from next wave and provide their serials by EOD so we can patch manifests.

supply-broker (alpha-logistics): Understood — will send uplift serials by EOD and signed amendment by tomorrow AM. We'll also push the return label PDFs to the RMA ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
